name: facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/examples/speech_recognition/data/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.create_asr_dataset: create an AsrDataset instance with audio paths, durations, target transcriptions, and vocabulary dictionary
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.extract_fbank_features: extract Kaldi-style fbank features from WAV audio files using torchaudio and apply MVN normalization
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.collate_asr_samples: collate a list of ASR dataset samples into a mini-batch using Seq2SeqCollater
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.get_asr_sample_size: get the frame size and target length tuple for a given sample index in the dataset
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.review_asr_dataset_class: review the AsrDataset class that represents speech audio and corresponding transcription data

facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.collate_samples_for_speech_recognition: create a Seq2SeqCollater instance and call collate to batch speech recognition samples into padded tensors

facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.review_seq2seq_collater_batch_output: review the Seq2SeqCollater collate method to understand batch structure with src_tokens, target, and prev_output_tokens

facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.calc_mean_invstddev: calculate the mean and inverse standard deviation of a 2-D PyTorch feature tensor
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.apply_mv_norm: apply mean-variance normalization to a batch of spectrogram feature tensors
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.lengths_to_encoder_padding_mask: convert a 1-D sequence lengths tensor into a 2-D binary encoder padding mask
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.encoder_padding_mask_to_lengths: convert a 2-D encoder padding mask tensor back into a 1-D sequence lengths tensor
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.review_data_utils: review the speech recognition data utilities module for tensor normalization and padding mask functions

facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.pack_replabels: pack a token sequence so that repeated symbols are replaced by replabels for ASG criterion training
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.unpack_replabels: unpack a token sequence so that replabels are replaced by their original repeated symbols
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.replabel_symbol: generate a replabel symbol string for a given repetition count index
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.review_pack_replabels: review the pack_replabels function to understand how repeated tokens are compressed into replabel indices
facebookresearch_avhubert/fairseq/exampl.review_unpack_replabels: review the unpack_replabels function to understand how replabel indices are expanded back into repeated tokens
